'''Sonie''' was the supposed aunt of [[Cerasi]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. In order to create a diversion for [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Cerasi told two guards that she was looking for her [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Wehutti]] in order to tell him that Sonie had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] in a [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenade]] attack.
